title: KPGU - Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University, Vadodara
content: At KPGU Vadodara New 2026 PhD Results Seat numbers of applicants who qualified for admission   and those who did not   are now displayed on the Doctoral Program page. View 2026 PhD Results   Established 2020 Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara. Established in 2021 by the Government of Gujarat, KPGU - formerly BITS Edu Campus - is recognized by UGC, AICTE, PCI, AYUSH, GNC and GSCPT.
